label: TP
reason: Two distinct vulnerabilities exist: (1) Insecure randomness - java.util.Random().nextGaussian() generates cryptographically weak random values used for session tokens (L54), and (2) XSS - user-controlled cookie values (rememberMe.getValue(), rememberMe.getName()) are directly concatenated into response.getWriter() output (L92-97) without encoding, allowing script injection through reflected cookie content.

evidence.note: Random nextGaussian() used for session key; user cookie values reflected unsanitized to response
